leadCapture.headline: Ready to Find Your El Paso Home?
leadCapture.description: Whether you're buying your first home, selling, or relocating to Fort Bliss — Lorena is here to guide you every step of the way.
about.bio1: I don't just find you a home; I make sure you can afford it. With over 10 years of banking experience and a BBA in Marketing from UTEP, I bring a financial strategist's mindset to every transaction.
about.bio2: Growing up in both El Paso and Cd. Juárez, I understand the unique pulse of our border community. Whether you prefer English or Spanish, I treat you like family.
servicesTabs.subtitle: Our Services
servicesTabs.title: How Lorena Helps
servicesTabs.buying.step1Desc: Discuss your goals, budget, and ideal neighborhoods in a no-pressure call.
servicesTabs.buying.step2Desc: Connect with our mortgage partner to lock in your buying power.
servicesTabs.buying.step3Desc: See curated listings that match your criteria with Lorena by your side.
servicesTabs.buying.step4Desc: Expert negotiation and guidance through closing — celebrate your new home!
servicesTabs.selling.step1Desc: Get a free, data-driven estimate of your home's market value.
servicesTabs.selling.step2Desc: Professional photography, staging tips, and a marketing plan built for maximum exposure.
servicesTabs.selling.step3Desc: MLS listing, social media, and targeted advertising to reach serious buyers.
servicesTabs.selling.step4Desc: Lorena negotiates the best price and guides you through a smooth closing.
servicesTabs.military.step1Desc: $0 down, no PMI — Lorena explains how to maximize your VA benefits.
servicesTabs.military.step2Desc: Find homes where your BAH covers the mortgage — we know the numbers.
servicesTabs.military.step3Desc: Tour neighborhoods near your gate with realistic commute times.
servicesTabs.military.step4Desc: Fast closings that work with your PCS timeline. No surprises.
